title: Poisson Autoregression on a Large Network with a Stochastic Block Model Structure
summary: We consider multivariate Poisson autoregressive processes evolving on random networks generated by a Stochastic Block Model. This framework extends existing network Poisson autoregressions by incorporating latent community structure and allowing for non-Markovian dependence, both excitatory and inhibitory. We establish a mean-field approximation and prove that the finite system converges to its limit at the optimal rate $N^{-1/2}$ in the quenched setting with overwhelming probability, both on average and in uniform norm.
